newsitem.title: USA: Labor talks continue at Kennecott Copper.
newsitem.headline: Labor talks continue at Kennecott Copper.

text.p: Labor talks at Kennecott Copper in Utah were continuing as the midnight local time expiry of the existing three-year deal neared.
"They talked over the weekend and they are continuing to talk today, and our goal is still to reach an agreement by midnight tonight," said Kennecott's spokeswoman Alexis Fernandez.
USWA officials were not available for comment.
Kennecott, a subsidiary of Britain's RTZ Corp, has been negotiating with seven international unions and 17 locals, but most of them belong to the United Steelworkers of America.
Some 1,800 Kennecott workers are represented by unions at the 310,000 short tons-a-year copper refinery.

"The majority of the local issues have been resolved, but there are a few local issues outstanding. Right now we are looking at the master contract which covers everybody, the wage and benefit package," Fernandez said.
